sown_area_conversion.claim_boundary: ABM reports physical operated grain area by default; mature sown-area forecast claims require an independently validated production conversion or endogenous cropping-intensity mechanism.

mechanism_candidate.parameter_evidence_reference: missing; requires official sown-area/cropping-intensity panel before forecast use
mechanism_candidate.parameter_claim_boundary: Audit-only production candidate. It can diagnose the G1 pathway, but cannot support mature national grain sown-area or yield forecast claims until it passes independent official backtests and benchmark gates.
mechanism_candidate.claim_boundary: Production-side sown-area mechanism candidate only; official grain_sown_area remains physical-area proxy unless forecast_usable passes provenance and benchmark guards.

capitalization.emergent_pass_through_claim_boundary: Model-internal emergent pass-through 0.01-0.03 via operational transfer ledger. Lower than stipulated 0.22 because transfer capacity constraints suppress rent capitalization. Priced auction contributes when capacity permits (23tx/14yr@30yr).

production.yield_mode_claim_boundary: legacy_stack: active yield path (multiplier stack). production_function_shadow: implemented in utils/yield_stack_runtime.py with NFPS-estimated elasticities (alpha=0.7026 land, beta=0.2547 labor, gamma=0.0173 capital; OLS on 5,654 obs, R2=0.61, returns-to-scale=0.9746). Input proxies are scale_factor, technology_multiplier, service_bonus_multiplier (NOT direct land/labor/capital measurements). shadow_cd_yield_kg trace field populated when yield_mode=production_function_shadow or when cobb_douglas.shadow_compare_enabled=true. The active returned yield remains legacy_stack unless a later audited production_function_active path is added. production_function_active: deferred. Requires direct factor input measurement at agent level (not just proxy multipliers).

cobb_douglas.claim_boundary: NFPS OLS estimates from 5,654 household-year observations (2009-2015). Capital is proxied by total production expense (exp_prod). No regional fixed effects, no endogeneity correction. Returns-to-scale = 0.9746. Replaces previous literature-anchored defaults (Fuglie & Rada 2013).

auxiliary_driver_panel.source: training-window official auxiliary national panel with hold-forward semantics
auxiliary_driver_panel.claim_boundary: Auxiliary drivers expose irrigation and disaster channels for mechanism audits. They are not by themselves strong calibration evidence or mature national forecast evidence.

irrigation.claim_boundary: Conservative candidate modifier relative to the earliest training-window irrigation ratio; must pass independent backtest before strong forecast claims.

disaster_loss.claim_boundary: Conservative disaster-loss candidate modifier using training-window affected-area ratios, with climate fallback only when panel data are missing.
